title: Degree-zero scalar-Hom compatibility on complex representatives
statement: Under the normalized scalar-Hom, section and zero-cycle data of the scalarHomZeroCompatibility node, the displayed degree-zero compatibility equation holds when P, M and N are objects represented directly by complexes under DerivedCategory.Q.

proof.text: Choose K-flat and K-injective complex representatives and compute the normalized zero-cycle image using the representative tensor-Hom square, the scalar transpose and the section comparison equations.
